stepActions.S01: Freeze the estate inventory, take supported backups of all source clusters, and verify restore procedures.
stepActions.S02: Add wld-platform-01 as the Fleet Management deployment target and validate DNS, NTP, certificates, capacity, and required connectivity without changing the management domain.
stepActions.S03: Export and checksum the supported VMware Aria Operations custom content before building the replacement cluster.
stepActions.S04: Deploy the sized VCF Operations 9.0.2 cluster on wld-platform-01 and configure collection for the fleet.
stepActions.S05: Import VMware Aria Automation 8.18.1 into Fleet Management and perform the supported upgrade to clustered VCF Automation 9.0.2 on wld-platform-01.
stepActions.S06: Deploy the sized VCF Operations for Logs 9.0.2 cluster on wld-platform-01 in parallel with the source Logs cluster.
stepActions.S07: Import supported Operations content, omit unsupported content and historical metrics, then validate collection and representative outputs.
stepActions.S08: Validate carried Automation services and deployments, repair lowercase ownership visibility where needed, and publish the new Identity Broker login URL.
stepActions.S09: Import supported Logs content, recreate integrations and syslog destinations, transfer the supported 90-day log window, and cut sources to the new VIP.
stepActions.S10: Complete cross-product acceptance, retain legacy systems for the rollback window, then decommission them without modifying management-domain assets.

stepRollbacks.S01: No production change has occurred; correct the backup or inventory failure and repeat the step.
stepRollbacks.S02: Remove only the new workload-domain deployment-target registration.
stepRollbacks.S03: Repeat the export from the unchanged source Operations cluster.
stepRollbacks.S04: Delete the incomplete workload-domain VCF Operations deployment and keep source Operations collecting.
stepRollbacks.S05: Use the supported Automation upgrade rollback and keep the source nodes isolated but recoverable.
stepRollbacks.S06: Delete the incomplete workload-domain Logs deployment and keep all sources on the legacy VIP.
stepRollbacks.S07: Return consumers to source Operations while correcting exported content.
stepRollbacks.S08: Return Automation access to the preserved source environment using the supported upgrade rollback.
stepRollbacks.S09: Point log sources back to the legacy VIP; both Logs clusters remain available in parallel.
stepRollbacks.S10: Do not decommission any legacy cluster until every acceptance and rollback-window gate is satisfied.
